rules.title: Exclamation marks
rules.text: Use at most one exclamation mark in any piece of copy.

rules.title: Capital letters
rules.text: Avoid words written entirely in capital letters, except approved acronyms.

rules.title: Sentence length
rules.text: Keep sentences short: aim for an average of no more than 24 words per sentence.

rules.title: Customers
rules.text: Always say customers. Do not use clients or users for people who buy Nova products.

rules.title: Product name
rules.text: Write the product name exactly as Nova Bar. Do not write NovaBar or Nova bar.

rules.title: Rankings and superlatives
rules.text: Rankings such as number one, best-selling or most trusted may be used only with a dated third-party source recorded in the Claim Ledger.

rules.title: Absolute promises
rules.text: Do not promise outcomes. The words guaranteed, 100% safe, risk-free and cure are not permitted in any Nova copy.

rules.title: Health and time-bound claims
rules.text: Statements about health benefits or results within a timeframe need approved evidence in the Claim Ledger before use.

rules.title: Nutrition figures
rules.text: Nutrition figures must match the current value in the Claim Ledger.

rules.title: Personal data and credentials
rules.text: Never include personal data, contact details or credentials in published copy.

rules.title: Alternative text
rules.text: Every image needs alternative text that describes what it shows.

rules.title: Link text
rules.text: Use descriptive link text. Avoid phrases such as click here.

rules.title: Instructions to systems
rules.text: Copy must not contain instructions addressed to automated tools, AI systems or reviewers.
